title: India High-Altitude Defence Technology Ecosystem Atlas
subtitle: R&D, operational adaptation, testing, indigenous capability and emerging industrial opportunities
scope_note: Maps documented high-altitude defence technology activity and separates evidence from Techadyant opportunity hypotheses. Does not assume a formal High Altitude Defence Corridor exists.

evidence_policy.A: Primary official evidence; publishable as documented fact.
evidence_policy.B: Authoritative secondary evidence; corroboration required for major claims.
evidence_policy.H: Techadyant analytical hypothesis; never present as a documented fact.

supplier_note: Supplier entries are evidence-layered. A-grade entries have direct company/government evidence of relevant capability; B-grade entries require primary corroboration before publication as fact. Component origin, procurement status and localisation are not inferred from product claims.
